budget.estimate_basis: Measured 16-cell assembly plus prior 5735-cell native first steps 142-330 seconds per path. New full-grid scans and new lapse convergence unmeasured; 900-second hard cap. Old endpoints only initial guesses; exact raw cache reuse.

claim: One native matter, two heat currents, 26-species transport and regular scalar spherical first step with radial metric constraint and a shared mass adjoint.
decision: Accept this finite assembly only if native residual, scalar equation, weighted mass-boundary identity, baryons, species and local rest cone all pass; otherwise retain failure and stop before larger runs.

symbolic.matter_work: Delta(aE)=-Rstar*Delta(a)-abar*gstar*Delta(phi)+abar*F; Rstar=mean(aR)*L(a0,a1), gstar=mean(a*alpha*trace)/abar, L=log(a1/a0)/(a1-a0) with its smooth diagonal value 1/a0. This is the same logarithmic metric work used by the native local paths.
symbolic.scalar_source: The same radial adjoint H yields scalar Pi source H*Ggeom*V*gstar/w_scalar. No inverse Pi.
symbolic.transport: F_i=-Delta_face(I_m)/(H_i*V_i), where I_m=dt*Hface*area*k*S_m_mid. Its H-weighted volume sum is exactly the time-integrated boundary flux.
symbolic.scope: Algebraic coupling construction only. Requires the stated finite matter-work equation, a shared discrete adjoint, positive metric branch and compatible transport flux. It has not been implemented or run in the full native spherical solver.

limitations: First step only, no time convergence.
Radial mass constraint and discrete total energy only, no full Einstein constraint convergence.
Scalar boundary ramp is a numerical control, not a companion or physical perturbation calibration.
No physical EOS certification or observational inference.
